physical-performance.target: Signed exact-candidate physical Windows performance and lifecycle
physical-performance.expected: Every launch, interaction, resource, resilience, and soak assertion passes on the declared physical architecture, and every numeric measurement satisfies the active release-performance budget.

assertions.description: Cold launch satisfies the active p95 budget with the required repeated samples.
Warm launch satisfies the active p95 budget with the required repeated samples.
Tray and flyout input acknowledgement satisfies the active p95 budget.
Dashboard refresh satisfies the documented p95 SLO under a declared representative dataset.
Local search satisfies the documented p95 SLO under a declared representative dataset.
Settings input acknowledgement satisfies the active p95 budget.
Local chat input acknowledgement satisfies the active p95 budget under a harmless fixture; provider latency is reported separately.
A declared representative incremental usage scan satisfies the active p95 budget without crash or hang.
Warm-idle normalized process CPU satisfies the active average budget for the prescribed duration.
Normalized process CPU satisfies the active p95 budget during the declared workload.
Private memory satisfies the active steady-state budget.
Process GPU utilization satisfies the active p95 budget and fallback behavior remains usable.
Warm-idle process disk writes satisfy the active rate budget.
Frame-time p95 and dropped-frame rate satisfy both active budgets on animated and scrolling surfaces.
Sleep and wake preserve a usable responsive app.
Explorer restart restores tray and activation behavior.
The 30-minute soak satisfies memory-growth, zero-crash, and zero-hang budgets.

accessibility-display.target: Narrator, keyboard, UI Automation, display scaling, themes, and multi-monitor behavior
accessibility-display.expected: Every accessibility and display assertion passes in a signed-in physical Windows desktop session.

assertions.description: The full UI Automation certification profile passes.
Narrator exposes useful names, roles, values, and state changes.
All required workflows are operable without a pointing device.
Keyboard focus order is logical and stable.
Keyboard focus remains visibly identifiable on every surface.
Status, error, progress, and completion changes are announced.
All required surfaces pass at 100 percent scaling.
All required surfaces pass at 150 percent scaling.
All required surfaces pass at 200 percent scaling.
Required surfaces remain legible and operable in Windows high contrast.
Reduced-motion settings remove nonessential movement without losing state.
Reduced-transparency settings preserve legibility and hierarchy.
Required surfaces remain usable at the prescribed narrow window size.
Required surfaces remain usable at the prescribed wide window size.
Moving between mixed-DPI monitors preserves scale, focus, and layout.

staging-cloud.target: Authorized isolated staging OAuth, App Check, TPM, and CloudVault behavior
staging-cloud.expected: Every staging assertion passes against the named non-production project with no secret leakage.

assertions.description: Evidence names the explicit authorization and isolated staging project, never production.
OAuth PKCE sign-in and callback succeed.
Cancellation, malformed callback, and state mismatch fail safely.
Token refresh and expiry behavior recover or fail closed as designed.
Revoked credentials are rejected and cleaned up.
Offline queueing and reconnect recovery preserve ordering and idempotency.
A valid App Check token is accepted by the staging enforcement surface.
Missing, malformed, expired, and invalid App Check tokens are rejected.
The physical TPM claim is minted and accepted only for the attested device.
CloudVault upload and download round trips preserve authenticated data.
Conflict, duplicate, ordering, and replay cases resolve safely.
Sign-out removes local tokens, queued privileged work, and cloud session state.
Config, logs, diagnostics, evidence, and child environments contain no secrets.

media-computer-use-safety.target: Physical Windows media, transfer, privileged input, authorization, and emergency-stop safety
media-computer-use-safety.expected: Every media and Computer Use safety assertion passes using harmless fixtures and authorized peers.

assertions.description: Screen capture, camera, and microphone permissions grant and deny safely.
Call interruption and recovery preserve safe state.
Screen-share interruption and recovery preserve safe state.
File-transfer interruption, retry, and cancellation preserve integrity.
Snapshots follow retention, redaction, and cleanup policy.
Received files preserve Mark of the Web and quarantine policy.
Protected and secure-desktop targets deny automation.
Privileged input requires the exact current approval and cannot reuse stale approval.
Phone and runtime controls can downgrade trust but cannot silently elevate it.
The global panic path halts input within the release latency budget.
Watchdog loss halts the session and leaves an audit record.
The remote kill switch halts and prevents privileged execution.
Audit-chain mutation, deletion, and terminal-entry tamper are detected.
Paired-phone authorization succeeds only for the intended session and action.
Replayed phone, broker, media, and transfer authorization is rejected.

store-update-lifecycle.target: Explicitly authorized private Store flight and update lifecycle
store-update-lifecycle.expected: Every private-flight install, update, recovery, activation, feed, and coexistence assertion passes.

assertions.description: Evidence names explicit authorization and a non-public Partner Center flight.
Private-flight clean install succeeds and launches responsively.
Upgrade from the prescribed predecessor preserves supported state and launches.
Package repair restores a usable signed installation.
The documented rollback or recovery path restores service safely.
Uninstall removes the package and reinstall returns a usable app.
Launch, protocol, file, toast, and startup activation routes behave as declared.
Repeated activation preserves single-instance routing.
A valid signed update feed is accepted and bound to its artifact.
A tampered feed or artifact is rejected.
An unauthorized downgrade is rejected.
Offline feed behavior remains usable and fails safely.
Store and direct-download identities coexist or conflict exactly as documented.
The candidate's winget publication eligibility and installer contract are verified.
